# Pki

`c.Pki` calls the API's Pki group. The certificates of the fleet.

## Methods

| Method                           | Returns                  | Permission | Description                         |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------- | ----------------------------------- |
| [`List(ctx, params)`](#list)     | `*Response[PKICertList]` | `pki:read` | List the certificates of the fleet. |
| [`Get(ctx, name, params)`](#get) | `*Response[PKICert]`     | `pki:read` | Get one certificate of a host.      |

### List

```go
func (s *PkiService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	params PkiListParams,
) (*Response[PKICertList], error)
```

List the certificates of the fleet.

Lists the certificates of the controller's host, the API's, the controller's
metrics and the NATS server's, and the certificates that each agent reports in
its registration, with their expiry. A certificate that a host has not made is
not made.

It sends `GET /api/pki/cert`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List the certificates of the fleet, `go run pki.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.List(ctx, client.PkiListParams{})
```

List the certificates of the fleet, with --hostname web-01,
`go run pki.go list-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.List(ctx, client.PkiListParams{Hostname: "web-01"})
```

### Get

```go
func (s *PkiService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	name string,
	params PkiGetParams,
) (*Response[PKICert], error)
```

Get one certificate of a host.

Reads one certificate of one host: the controller's host when the hostname is
empty, or the agent of the hostname.

It sends `GET /api/pki/cert/{name}`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Get one certificate of a host, `go run pki.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Get(ctx, "api", client.PkiGetParams{})
```

Get one certificate of a host, with --name agent-metrics --hostname web-01,
`go run pki.go get-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Get(ctx, "agent-metrics", client.PkiGetParams{Hostname: "web-01"})
```
